title: 3 ways to declutter your phone today

scenes.headline: Phone feeling cluttered?
scenes.narration: Does your phone feel cluttered? Here are three practical ways to organize it.

scenes.headline: Group apps by purpose
scenes.body: Keep everyday tools in one predictable spot.
scenes.narration: Put your most used apps where your thumb can easily reach them.

scenes.headline: Remove unused shortcuts
scenes.body: A clean screen is easier to navigate.
scenes.narration: Remove shortcuts you rarely tap. You can still find the apps in your app list.

scenes.headline: Keep your best tools visible
scenes.body: Save this checklist and subscribe for more.
scenes.narration: Keep the most useful tools easy to find, and save this simple checklist for later.
